title: Async/await, Future, and executors

spans.text: Goal: apply “Async/await, Future, and executors” to a real program or device. The key principle is: The runtime schedules futures, and libraries such as HTTP clients must match its async ecosystem. In a project, follow this guidance: Async does not parallelize CPU-heavy work; long computations may need a blocking pool or dedicated thread.
